title: Chris M NDE 5096
content: I do not remember anything about this day, other than my afterlife experience. My son and I were digging a ditch. He said that I had trouble breathing and I sat down a lot. About 5:15 or so, I went into the house to get a drink of water. My wife was a nurse until illness struck her about ten years ago. She said I didn't look well and I was having massive pain in my chest. I lay down on the den floor and told her I loved her and my face turned black and my heart stopped along with my breathing. She started CPR and called 911. Fifteen minutes later the ambulance showed up. My other son was the paramedic on the scene. He hit me three times with the paddles and could not get me going. They worked on me for forty-five more minutes before they got my heart going. They put me in the ambulance and away we went. I died again in the ambulance and they called my son in the other ambulance and told him I was gone. He told them to keep on me until we got to the hospital. When we got there, my Mom and Dad were standing at the door of the emergency room. My Mom had a heart attack. Later, without knowing, I asked how my Mom was. Anyway, they put two stents in and four days later, I woke up in a regular room. While I was dead, I appeared in a huge lit up expanse. I saw both of my grandmothers. They both hugged me and my Dad's Mom took my hand and said to come on she had someone she wanted me to meet. We walked on this long golden road. It was one sheet of gold so wide you could fit a thousand people across it. I saw a man with long white hair and robe with gold trim playing with children. He arose, marshaled the kids away, and walked towards us. When He reached us, my Grandma said, 'Honey, this is your Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.' He touched my forehead with two fingers of His left hand and said, 'It's not your time. You cannot stay, you things to do for Me.' I said that I was home and didn't want to leave. He said, 'You have to go. When it is your time I will call for you so, be ready.' Then it ended. I woke up four days later as they were taking me to my room from the intensive care unit. Here's the problem. Nobody asked me how I felt about it. I loved it, of course, but I have so many questions. I cry at the drop of a hat. Everyone said that it was a wonderful experience and yes, it was, but it screwed me up in a way. I've kept my feelings about the whole ordeal bottled up for three years. I tell everyone about the experience. Joyously. I love my Jesus, but dang, what a ride. I feel and see things I can't explain. Sometimes I feel I'm going nuts.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: A man with long white hair and robe with gold trim; identified by grandmother as 'your Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.' He touched the experiencer's forehead with two fingers of His left hand and spoke.
arrival.other_being_detail: Both grandmothers were present; grandmother (dad's mom) took his hand and led him to meet Jesus; grandmothers hugged him.

environment.environment_other_detail: Huge lit up expanse; long golden road 'one sheet of gold so wide you could fit a thousand people across it.'

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Jesus said: 'It's not your time. You cannot stay, you things to do for Me.'

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel described; arrival directly into a lit expanse with deceased relatives, then meeting Jesus who told him to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Long golden road described as a single sheet of gold wide enough for 'a thousand people across'; Jesus 'playing with children' before approaching.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Honey, this is your Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.'; 'It's not your time. You cannot stay, you things to do for Me.'; 'You have to go. When it is your time I will call for you so, be ready.'; 'I was home and didn't want to leave.'; 'I feel and see things I can't explain.'
